styles.name: Line
styles.description: A precise 1.75px outline with round caps and joins. The default for any interface.

styles.name: Solid
styles.description: The filled companion to Line: bold mass, crisp knockouts, solid arrowheads, and parts, badges and slashes set apart by a precise gap.

styles.name: Duo
styles.description: The line drawing over a soft tonal fill of the object's mass. Recolour the tone with --with-duo and the accent detail with --with-duo-accent.

styles.name: Gloss
styles.description: Inflated, glossy and pillowy: soft-vinyl forms with carved specular highlights, in one flat colour.

styles.name: Engrave
styles.description: Banknote intaglio: a crisp contour that swells on its shadow side, swelling burin hatching that models light and shade, and a hatched cast shadow.

styles.name: Blueprint
styles.description: A drafting-table drawing that shows its work: chain-dash centre lines, fillet construction, a dimension line and open control nodes around a precise 1.25px line. Set --with-accent for a two-tone blueprint.

styles.name: Sketch
styles.description: Marker ink over pencil: loose hand-drawn strokes that cross at corners and overshoot their loops, with light shadow-side hatching.

styles.name: Glass
styles.description: Soft frosted glass: a calm colour glows through a translucent pane with a fine light rim and a gentle shadow.

styles.name: Kawaii
styles.description: Chubby pastel shapes with a soft thick outline and a tiny blushing face: the cutest icons on the web.

styles.name: Sticker
styles.description: Die-cut vinyl stickers in candy colours: bold ink outlines, a puffy white border, a soft drop shadow, a glossy shine and a sparkle or two.

styles.name: Pixel
styles.description: Hand-tuned 16-bit pixel art on a 24 grid: crisp one-pixel outlines, a shaded sprite body and a highlight pixel. Pixel-perfect at 24, 48 and 72 px.

styles.name: Retro
styles.description: Warm 70s vibes: chunky outlines, sunset-striped fills and a hard offset shadow, like a vintage patch.

styles.name: Luxe
styles.description: Premium multi-layered 3D: jewel enamel, polished gold and ruby set in deep extruded slabs, with soft shadows, lit chamfers and crisp highlights.

styles.name: Bauhaus
styles.description: Bauhaus compositions in miniature: circles, arches, half and quarter discs and pills in red, yellow, blue and black.

styles.name: Skeuo
styles.description: Skeuomorphic: every icon is a tactile object in a real material (paper, leather, metal, brass, wood, glass), lit from above with soft shadows, inner walls and debossed detail.

styles.name: Anime
styles.description: Anime cel style: crisp tapered ink line art, flat cel colour with one hard shadow tone, bright specular shine and the odd sparkle, in sky blue, sakura pink and warm gold.

styles.name: Gothic
styles.description: Cathedral craft: carved limestone, stained glass in ruby, sapphire, gold and emerald set in dark lead, pointed arches, tracery and rose windows.

styles.name: Pastel
styles.description: Soft pastel colour fields in lavender, peach, mint, baby blue, butter and blush, with gentle tonal depth.

styles.name: Coquette
styles.description: Ballet-pink romance: blush satin objects tied with ribbon-red bows, pearls, lace and delicate gold.

styles.name: Plush
styles.description: Stuffed-toy icons sewn from felt: puffy panels, dark piping, running stitches, buttons and embroidered details.

styles.name: Clay
styles.description: Soft faux-3D clay: plump, inflated objects of matte clay and soft vinyl, lit from above with a visible thickness, a soft ground shadow and glossy candy badges.

styles.name: Bento
styles.description: Feature-grid tiles: each glyph sits on a soft gradient squircle with a hairline highlight, in a crisp duotone with a gentle lift.

styles.name: Suite
styles.description: Office-suite colour icons: layered flat planes in calm blues and violets with gentle gradients, folded corners and bright badges.

styles.name: Dock
styles.description: App-icon tiles: a glossy continuous-corner squircle in a rich two-tone colour carrying a raised, softly shaded glyph, so a set of icons looks like a colourful dock.

styles.name: Liquid
styles.description: Clear, thick, refractive glass: a faintly tinted body with a crisp specular rim, a deep refraction edge, a soft lens highlight and a coloured caustic glow.

styles.name: Chrome
styles.description: Liquid metal Y2K chrome: every icon an inflated, polished object with a mirror horizon, bevelled rim, crisp glint and soft shadow.

styles.name: Soft 3D
styles.description: Soft studio-lit 3D: real objects in a gentle 3/4 view with volume, rounded bevels and natural materials, symbols as rounded front-facing forms, people as soft 3D busts.

styles.name: Brutal
styles.description: Neo-brutalism: thick black outlines, flat loud colours and a hard offset shadow, like the boldest startup sites.

styles.name: Utsav
styles.description: Indian festive craft: warm marigold forms with a plum outline, a fine gold inner line, rangoli dot-work, rosette badges and a tiny diya flame.

styles.name: Rangoli
styles.description: Indian festival icons for Diwali, Durga Puja and Holi: clean objects in a warm festive glow, each with one motif of its own (rangoli petals, lotus, toran, marigold, diya flame or gulal).

styles.name: Halloween
styles.description: Spooky-cute Halloween: chunky pumpkin, witch-purple, midnight and bone-white forms with a dark outline, carved details glowing with candlelight, slime goo dripping from broad edges, peeking eyes, and a tiny bat, spider or moon.

styles.name: Christmas
styles.description: Cosy holiday icons: cranberry, pine and gold forms with a soft warm light, a snow cap resting on every top edge, candy-cane stripes and a sprig of holly.

styles.name: Lunar New Year
styles.description: Lunar New Year: lucky red lacquer with a gold-foil rim, gold and jade parts, paper-cut cloud scrolls, silk tassels and plum blossoms.

styles.name: Valentine
styles.description: Cute Valentine's stickers: pink-to-red cartoon shapes in a warm berry outline, a soft shine, polka dots and sprinkles, tiny blushing faces and little floating hearts.
